purpose: Teach: 六本木/しみじみ/芸人/クーラー/日焼け/コップ/数える/茶色

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、六本木、絶対、新カフェ、絶対、行ってきたわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, I'm serious—I absolutely went to that new café in Roppongi.
lines.style: Bright, rapid-fire delivery with clear beats on each 'absolute.' Eager to share. Forward momentum, like she can't wait to get to the good part.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、しみじみ、絶対、思うんだけど、お店、絶対、本当に、絶対、感謝、絶対、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, honestly though—I really do feel deeply grateful for your shop.
lines.style: Softer attack, introspective. Slow down on 'deeply feel'—she's being genuine, not performed. Quiet conviction underneath. Slight catch like she's choosing her words carefully.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お気に入りの、絶対、芸人、絶対、テレビ、絶対、出てたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your favorite comedian was on TV the other day—did you catch it?
lines.style: Playful lift at the end of the thought. Quick, intimate—assuming shared knowledge. A small brightness, like she's offering her a gift.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、クーラー、絶対、効きすぎね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Your shop's AC is honestly way too strong though.
lines.style: Light, wry observation. Delivered with affection, not complaint. Slight smile in the voice—the tone of someone who knows she can tease.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、海で、絶対、日焼け、絶対、しちゃった、メイちゃん
lines.en: I got absolutely sunburned at the beach, can you believe it?
lines.style: Self-deprecating wry humor. Quick, almost laughing at herself. Shake-of-the-head cadence, like 'what was I thinking?'

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、新作の、絶対、コップ、絶対、お店に、絶対、入れたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and we put the new cup design in the shop—it looks great.
lines.style: Warm, pleased announcement. Easy confidence. Slight rise at the end—offering it like a small victory she wants to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、毎日の、絶対、お客様、絶対、数える、絶対、楽しいよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Counting the customers every day is actually kind of fun, isn't it?
lines.style: Gentle, thoughtful appreciation. Slow enough to let the sentiment breathe. The warmth of noticing something small together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の床、絶対、茶色、絶対、にしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: We painted the shop floor that nice brown color you liked.
lines.style: Soft, straightforward delivery—a quiet act of care mentioned without fanfare. Slight warm lilt at the end, like 'I thought of you when we did.'
